title: HI growth initiative; report to legislature.
bodyText: The development corporation shall submit an annual report to the legislature no later than twenty days prior to the convening of a regular session on the specific annual outcome achieved through the activities and expenditures of the HI growth initiative.
bodyHtml: [§206M-72]  HI growth initiative; report to legislature.  The development corporation shall submit an annual report to the legislature no later than twenty days prior to the convening of a regular session on the specific annual outcome achieved through the activities and expenditures of the HI growth initiative. [L 2019, c 56, pt of §2]
